desktop.$description: DES-03 (PLAN_V2_1_POLISH): the desktop app's and the web console's base sizes, so 100% looks like the owner's 90-95% without a default zoom. Whole pixels only. The phone keeps Material sizes (not generated for it). UX-20 (title row), DES-01 (rail and badges), DES-02 (Record) and DES-08 (avatar) sizes too.

height.$description: UX-20: the one title row on a Mac: the window's buttons in the rail's top cell, the panel's name, then the page's toolbar

rail-top-fullscreen.$description: Full screen hides the window's buttons: the rail's top cell shrinks to this

height-windows.$description: UX-20 on Windows (v21_win_titlebar): the window's own title row, in place of the system's title bar

keep-clear.$description: Nothing that can be clicked within this of the window's left edge in the title row

lights-left.$description: The Mac's three window buttons and 4 px round them, kept free of drag regions: trafficLightPosition x + 1 - 4

lights-width.$description: Three 12 px lights 8 px apart (52) + 4 px each side

lights-height.$description: A 12 px light + 4 px above and below

min-width.$description: The field at the row's end shrinks to this; below it (with the least drag room) it becomes a search button

max-width.$description: The field's width at the row's end, as Mail, Notes and Finder have it

preferred-width.$description: Between min-width and max-width, with the window

drag-room.$description: The least free space kept between the title and the field for dragging the window

closing-opacity.$description: UX-03: a panel dragged below its closing width fades to this; let go and it closes

width.$description: UX-20 on Windows: Minimize, Maximize and Close, as wide as the system's own, the row's height tall

pill-width.$description: The selected place: an accent-tint pill behind its icon

width.$description: DES-02: the Record split button, a joined pill

height.$description: DES-01: the number badge (only Activity's), on the icon's top-right corner

ring.$description: In the rail's background colour, so the badge looks cut out of the icon

inset.$description: The badge's centre this far in from the icon's corner

rail.$description: DES-08: the avatar in the rail, inside a 40 px click area

ring.$description: The inner ring every avatar has (role.avatar.ring)
